target_subject: a group of protesters in an urban street

Street-level view showing traffic lights, bicycles, and pedestrians; some individuals wear face masks

Two Colombian national flags attached to wooden poles, one larger and higher, both fluttering in wind, each displaying the national coat of arms centered on the yellow stripe.

symbolic_mapping: the sign’s accusation maps to institutional betrayal
flags map to contested national identity
philosophy_interpretations.interpretation: The image embodies a public assertion of civic agency against perceived illegitimate authority, where symbolic national markers are reclaimed to demand accountability.
alternative_interpretations: The scene may reflect routine civic engagement without explicit confrontation—e.g., commemoration or awareness-raising—given the presence of diverse attire and non-aggressive postures among some participants.
limitations: The specific intent behind each individual’s participation cannot be determined from posture or expression alone; some may be observers rather than activists.

man wearing red bandana as neck covering
